put.summary: Explicitly retire the exact sealed epoch into an empty bounded current epoch
put.description: Admin PAT and live active-administrator check before any body polling. The FULL owned transaction rechecks authority, exact fingerprint/seal key, global key and retained graph. At most two renewals retain two retired plus one current epoch. No reviews/selections/grants/enabled intent carry forward. A ten-second body deadline inside the 25-second command deadline; dropping HTTP waiter never aborts an admitted owner. Location retains the known renewal URL. All successful/structured results are passive; execution unavailable. No auto-approval, retry or URL follow.

version.description: Exact canonical full SemVer, including build metadata.

grants.description: Explicit complete replacement. Current host catalog is empty; no grants can be approved.

intent.description: Original review intent for review receipts; null for select/clear. Historical intent is not current authorization.

expected_review_revision.description: Original select request review revision; null for review/clear. Canonical decimal string 1..i64MAX.

PolicyRenewalRequest.description: Strict raw SDK request, no command envelope. Complete encoded HTTP body (including whitespace) is capped at 1,024 bytes before deserialization. Host generates the destination epoch; no requested approval/grant/activation fields.

oneOf.description: Canonical positive decimal account ID within i64 range.

PolicyRenewalReceipt.description: Immutable original transition evidence. Source/destination epochs and fingerprints differ. Historical destination need not be current. Canonical request bytes and file inventory are never returned.

gate.description: Compact gate from the same committing/historical read transaction. Applied is Open and matches receipt destination; historical gate need not match it. Retention-full remains Sealed.

PolicyRenewalMutationResult.description: No executable authority, grants or enabled intent. Retention-full 409 creates no receipt or reserved key and changes no epoch.

PolicyRenewalReceiptResult.description: Receipt-only historical response, historical=true. Follow no returned URL automatically. Inspect gate separately; these are not one atomic snapshot.
